content:
ana: Heads-up — I'm running a simulated restore in staging at 10:00 PT. Focus: encrypted snapshots, RBAC for temporary restore service account, and audit log chain-of-custody. I'll post short checks and results.

devon: SGTM. Share the quick checklist you want validated so I can follow along.

ana: Checklist: 1) verify snapshot SSE metadata, 2) check KMS key id and key policy allows decrypt for temp SA, 3) confirm audit logs (s3/getobject, kms/decrypt) are ingested and immutable, 4) run a decrypt attempt from the restore pod, 5) simulate failure mode when KMS is throttled.

priya: Add RBAC sanity: temp-restore-sa should be limited TTL and only have kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:DescribeKey and s3:GetObject on the snapshot prefix. No broader access.

devon: quick S3 check I run locally: 
```bash
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups --key snapshots/staging/restore-2025-11-02.tar.gz
```
Expect headers: ServerSideEncryption: aws:kms and SSEKMSKeyId present.

mike: also check object metadata for a customer-managed tag we set: x-amz-meta-tenant-id -> should be present.

priya: example minimal KMS policy for the temp SA (attach to role assumed by restore pod):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"
    }
  ]
}
```
Keep it scoped to the single CMK.

ana: Running head-object now... attaching output snippets.

ana: ```
{
  "ServerSideEncryption": "aws:kms",
  "SSEKMSKeyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789",
  "Metadata": {"x-amz-meta-tenant-id":"tenant-42"}
}
```
Looks good.

security-bot: PRE-CHECK: audit-collector status: OK, log retention policy: 365d, write-mode: append-only.

mike: KMS policy check: the CMK key policy currently has a wildcard for our SRE role. We should remove iam:Principal:* allowance and limit to specific restore role ARNs. Small vuln triage item.

priya: Agreed. I'll prepare a patch to tighten the policy. Will include justification and runbook note to rotate grants if restore fails.

devon: Next: attempt decrypt from restore pod (will assume temp role). Command: 
```bash
kms_output=$(aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://snapshot.key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789 --query Plaintext --output text)
```
Expect success and no access denied.

ana: Decrypt attempt: FAILED initially with AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt.

mike: Reaction: :eyes: do we have the role ARN in the key policy? maybe the role grant on the CMK is missing for the temp SA.

ana: Key policy shows explicit deny for non-prod roles due to an older restriction. That explains it. I'm removing deny for the restore role temporarily and will record the change in the runbook.

security-bot: Audit log entry created: {"actor":"ana","action":"kms:PutKeyPolicy","resource":"abcd-ef01-2345-6789","ts":1955554378} (immutable).

priya: Good. After enabling, re-run decrypt. If success, note in runbook: "temporary policy change made; escalate to security for review before prod".

ana: Re-run decrypt -> SUCCESS. Confirmed snapshot can be restored.

devon: Now exercise throttled KMS failure mode: use fault-injector to delay kms:Decrypt to 500ms and see timeout behavior of restore job.

sre-oncall: Will watch metrics. If restore latency > 5s per chunk, fallback should switch to fallback-model in runtime-config. I'll monitor.

ana: Fault inject run: observed restore retries, some GetObject repeated, total restore time doubled, but fallback kick-in worked and application-level degrade path succeeded. Logged details in thread runbook.

mike: Action items: 1) priya to push KMS key policy tighten PR (remove wildcard) 2) ana to document temporary policy change and rollback steps 3) devon to add automated pre-restore policy checks to CI (head-object + kms:SimulatePrincipalPolicy) 4) sre-oncall to add alert if audit logs miss expected kms/s3 events within 10 minutes of restore.

priya: I'll open the PR now, include risk assessment and test plan.

security-bot: RUNBOOK UPDATE: simulated-restore-enc-check v1.2 appended with results and remediation steps.

ana: Thanks all. If anyone wants the full log bundle it's at s3://redwood-backups/staging/runbooks/sim-restore-1955554321.tar.gz :thumbsup:

mike: +1 closing out, follow-up during next security retro.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged — monitoring rules will be created by EOD.
